lines.text: It was dark by five, and Leo's camp dinner turned into a squinting contest.
Every time he looked at a friend, his headlamp blinded them.
Here's the fix. At camp, tilt your headlamp down or switch it off when you talk to people.
Hang one soft lantern from a tent loop instead, so everyone can see without the glare.
Same dinner, warm light, nobody squinting.
Save this before your next camping trip.
